visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair is seen eating a snack from a paper wrapper at her desk, which is cluttered with office supplies, a colorful keyboard, and plush toys. (2) The camera shifts to another young woman with long hair wearing an earbud, typing on a silver laptop and turning to speak towards the camera with a confused expression. (3) A hand holding an anime figurine points its foot at the keys of a standard white keyboard while others watch nearby. (4) A third woman with long hair and a beige cardigan sits at her desk with a vibrant pink keyboard, holding a large white rabbit plushie and explaining a concept with animated gestures. (5) The woman in the beige cardigan continues her explanation, laughing and pointing toward the screen while several small graphics of keyboards and typing hands appear on screen.
